toyota-camry.overview: America's best-selling sedan for two decades. Reliable, efficient, and packed with safety tech as standard. A no-drama daily driver that consistently leads its segment in long-term resale value.
toyota-camry.drives_like: Smooth, composed, and quiet at highway speeds. Light steering makes city driving effortless. The hybrid variant is the sweet spot — instant low-end torque and 51 mpg combined.
features: Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 (Pre-Collision, Lane Departure Alert, Adaptive Cruise) — standard
9-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
Optional Hybrid powertrain delivering up to 51 mpg combined
Heated front seats and steering wheel (XSE and above)
Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
toyota-camry.best_for: Commuters, families, and anyone who wants peace-of-mind reliability

honda-accord.overview: A perennial Car-of-the-Year contender. Sleek modern styling wraps a class-leading interior and engaging driving dynamics. The Accord routinely outsmarts more expensive luxury sedans on long road trips.
honda-accord.drives_like: More engaging than a Camry — sharper steering, firmer chassis, but still composed and comfortable. The 2.0T sport trim feels genuinely quick.
features: Honda Sensing safety suite (Collision Mitigation, Road Departure Mitigation) — standard
Google built-in with Google Maps, Assistant, and Play Store (EX-L and above)
Optional 204 hp Hybrid achieving up to 48 mpg combined
Heated front seats and heated steering wheel
honda-accord.best_for: Buyers wanting Camry reliability with more driving engagement and a higher-end cabin

bmw-3-series.overview: The benchmark sport sedan for 40 years. Surgical steering, perfectly balanced chassis, and a rev-happy turbo inline-4 that makes every commute feel a little more special.
bmw-3-series.drives_like: Telepathic. The 3 Series sets the standard for steering feel and chassis balance in the segment. The optional M Sport package adds adaptive dampers and sharper limits without ruining ride quality.
features: Optional M Sport package with adaptive M suspension
Driving Assistant (Lane Departure Warning, Pedestrian Warning) — standard
Comfort Access keyless entry with hands-free trunk
bmw-3-series.best_for: Driving enthusiasts who still need 4 doors and a back seat

mercedes-benz-c-class.overview: Looks like a baby S-Class, inside and out. The 2024 C-Class brings 'Hey Mercedes' voice control, augmented-reality navigation, and a portrait infotainment screen straight from the flagship.
mercedes-benz-c-class.drives_like: Plush and refined first, sporty second — the opposite of a 3 Series. The mild-hybrid 48V system fills in low-end torque seamlessly. AMG variants change the character entirely.
features: 11.9-inch portrait MBUX touchscreen with AR navigation
Mild-hybrid 48V system adding 20 hp of boost
Heated and ventilated front seats with optional massage
mercedes-benz-c-class.best_for: Buyers who want luxury feel and tech, not lap times

hyundai-sonata.overview: Bold-styled midsize sedan refreshed for 2024 with seamless front lighting. Exceptional value — equips like a luxury car at midsize-sedan money. Hybrid and N Line performance versions both excellent.
hyundai-sonata.drives_like: Smooth and quiet for the base model; the N Line is genuinely quick with 290 hp. Hyundai's chassis tuning has caught up to the Japanese benchmarks.
features: Optional Hybrid powertrain achieving up to 47 mpg combined
Highway Driving Assist 2 with lane centering
Heated and ventilated front seats with available Nappa leather
hyundai-sonata.best_for: Value-seekers who want premium tech without the premium price

kia-k5.overview: Aggressively styled midsize sedan with the segment's best warranty. The GT trim makes 290 hp from a 2.5L turbo — genuine fun for under $35K.
kia-k5.drives_like: Sportier than a Camry, sharper than an Accord. The GT trim with its 8-speed dual-clutch is the most driver-focused sub-$35K sedan you can buy.
features: Kia Drive Wise safety suite (FCA, BCA, RCCA) — standard
10.25-inch touchscreen with wireless CarPlay & Android Auto
Available GT trim with 290 hp 2.5L turbo and 8-speed DCT
Highway Driving Assist with adaptive cruise
kia-k5.best_for: Sedan buyers who want sport-trim performance and long warranty coverage

nissan-altima.overview: Comfortable midsize sedan and the only one in its class offering all-wheel drive. ProPILOT Assist makes long highway drives noticeably less tiring.
nissan-altima.drives_like: Comfort-tuned and soft, with the optional VC-Turbo adding real punch (248 hp) for SR trim buyers. AWD trims are a snow-belt favorite.
features: ProPILOT Assist with adaptive cruise + lane centering
8-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
Zero Gravity front seats with extra lumbar support
Heated front seats and steering wheel
Optional Around View Monitor with moving-object detection
nissan-altima.best_for: Buyers in snow regions or anyone prioritizing seat comfort

audi-a4.overview: Refined compact luxury sedan with Quattro all-wheel drive standard. Cabin quality is segment-leading and the Virtual Cockpit Plus digital cluster is still the best in the business.
audi-a4.drives_like: Composed and unflappable. Less playful than a 3 Series, more solid than a C-Class — a quiet, confident touring sedan. The S4 variant adds genuine performance bite.
features: Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus 12.3-inch digital cluster
Audi Pre Sense Front collision warning — standard
Heated and ventilated front sport seats
Available Sport package with adaptive damping
audi-a4.best_for: All-weather drivers who want German build quality without 3 Series steering

lexus-es.overview: Whisper-quiet luxury sedan with legendary Lexus reliability. The 300h Hybrid achieves 44 mpg combined — best-in-class for any luxury sedan.
lexus-es.drives_like: Serenely smooth. The ES isolates passengers from the road like a Lexus should. Steering is light and accurate but not sporty. The F Sport trim adds adaptive variable suspension.
features: 12.3-inch touchscreen with wireless CarPlay & Android Auto
Dynamic Radar Cruise Control with curve speed management
Lexus complimentary maintenance for 2 years / 25K miles
lexus-es.best_for: Buyers who prize quiet, reliability, and long-term ownership economics

genesis-g70.overview: Korean luxury sport sedan that punches well above its price. Standout fastback styling, sharp dynamics, and complimentary scheduled maintenance for 3 years.
genesis-g70.drives_like: Genuinely engaging. The 3.3T Sport trim's twin-turbo V6 makes 365 hp and the chassis tuning rivals BMW. Brembo brakes on Sport trims tighten everything up further.
features: Heated and ventilated Nappa leather seats
Genesis Active Safety Control with Highway Driving Assist
Suede-like headliner and microfiber sport steering wheel
genesis-g70.best_for: BMW-curious buyers who want more luxury features per dollar

toyota-rav4.overview: America's best-selling SUV. Practical packaging, hybrid efficiency (40 mpg), and the only PHEV in its class — the RAV4 Prime — with 42 miles of EV-only range.
toyota-rav4.drives_like: Tall, comfortable, and easy to maneuver. The TRD Off-Road trim adds genuine trail capability. The Prime PHEV is surprisingly quick (0-60 in 5.7 sec).
features: Available Prime PHEV with 42-mile EV-only range
TRD Off-Road trim with all-terrain tires and tuned suspension
toyota-rav4.best_for: Active families, light off-roaders, and EV-curious buyers (Prime)

ford-explorer.overview: Three-row family SUV built on a rear-drive-based platform for towing capability. From efficient 4-cyl turbo to 400 hp ST and Hybrid — there's an Explorer for every need.
ford-explorer.drives_like: Big and confident, with surprisingly precise steering for its size. The ST trim drives like a sport sedan in a hurry. Hybrid feels seamless in stop-and-go.
features: Available 400 hp ST trim with 3.0L EcoBoost V6
Power-folding third row standard on most trims
ford-explorer.best_for: Three-row families, light tow vehicles, road-trippers

tesla-model-x.overview: Falcon-wing electric SUV with up to 7 seats. The Plaid trim is the quickest production SUV ever made — 2.5 sec to 60 mph from a 1,020 hp tri-motor setup.
tesla-model-x.drives_like: Instant. The Plaid's acceleration is physically uncomfortable. The standard Long Range is still faster than most sports cars. Air suspension is plush at highway speeds.
features: Falcon Wing rear doors with sensors to avoid obstacles
17-inch cinematic center display with HW4 self-driving hardware
Tesla Supercharger network access (now opening to other EVs)
22-speaker premium audio with Active Road Noise Reduction
Bioweapon Defense Mode HEPA cabin filtration
Tri-zone automatic climate with rear heated seats
tesla-model-x.best_for: Buyers wanting maximum EV utility + supercar acceleration

porsche-cayenne.overview: Sport luxury SUV that drives like a 911 on stilts. The 2024 refresh brings new dual-screen cabin tech. Engines range from V6 to a 650 hp V8 in the Turbo GT.
porsche-cayenne.drives_like: Like no other SUV. Adaptive air suspension with active anti-roll keeps it flat through corners that would upset a sedan. The Turbo GT laps Nurburgring in 7:38.
features: Available air suspension with PASM adaptive damping
Sport Chrono Package with launch control
Available rear-axle steering for tighter turning
porsche-cayenne.best_for: Buyers who refuse to give up sports-car dynamics for SUV practicality

porsche-911-carrera.overview: Sixty years of evolutionary refinement. The 911's rear-engine layout, twin-turbo flat-six soundtrack, and telepathic chassis remain the gold standard for sports cars.
porsche-911-carrera.drives_like: Sublime. Steering communicates every grain of road texture. The PDK transmission shifts in milliseconds; the optional 7-speed manual rewards skill. Limits are extremely high.
features: Sport Chrono Package with launch control and rev-matching
Available BOSE Surround Sound or Burmester High-End
porsche-911-carrera.best_for: Drivers who want the most perfectly engineered sports car ever made

chevrolet-corvette-c8.overview: First mid-engine Corvette. Supercar performance at attainable prices — 2.9 sec to 60 mph and a removable roof panel, all for under $70K. Z06 variant pushes 670 hp.
chevrolet-corvette-c8.drives_like: Like a junior Ferrari. The mid-engine layout delivers exceptional balance. The 6.2L LT2 V8 is loud and visceral. Magnetic Ride Control optional damping is fast and intelligent.
features: Magnetic Selective Ride Control (Z51 and above)
Removable Targa roof panel — stores in rear trunk
Optional Front Lift System (records GPS locations)
chevrolet-corvette-c8.best_for: Sports-car buyers who want supercar speed at half supercar price

ferrari-296-gtb.overview: Plug-in hybrid V6 supercar that redefines Ferrari for the electric era. 819 hp combined output, 25 km EV-only range, and the most sublime mid-engine balance the marque has ever produced.
ferrari-296-gtb.drives_like: Otherworldly. The hybrid V6 fills low-end torque the V8 generation lacked. Side-Slip Control 7.0 manages oversteer with surgical precision. Steering is impossibly direct.
features: 3.0L V6 twin-turbo + electric motor (819 hp combined)
25 km EV-only range with eDrive mode
16-inch curved HD driver display (curved behind the steering wheel)
Manettino driving mode selector (Wet, Sport, Race, CT-Off, ESC-Off, Qualify)
Carbon fiber steering wheel with capacitive touch controls
ferrari-296-gtb.best_for: Buyers who want the most advanced mid-engine Ferrari ever built

ford-mustang-dark-horse.overview: Track-focused Mustang flagship with a high-revving 5.0L V8 (500 hp) and a Tremec 6-speed manual standard. The most powerful naturally-aspirated 5.0 Coyote ever produced.
ford-mustang-dark-horse.drives_like: Old-school muscle car energy with modern chassis tech. The Tremec shifter is crisp. MagneRide damping keeps the live-axle rear shockingly composed on broken pavement.
features: 500 hp 5.0L Coyote V8 with strengthened block
Tremec TR-3160 6-speed manual — standard (10-speed auto optional)
Handling Package adds Drift Brake (electronic e-brake)
ford-mustang-dark-horse.best_for: Manual-transmission devotees who want a track-day Mustang

tesla-model-3.overview: Refreshed for 2024 with quieter cabin, sharper styling, and longer range (341 miles). The world's best-selling EV — and it shows in the polish.
tesla-model-3.drives_like: Instant torque from a stoplight makes traffic disappear. Steering is light, ride is firm. The 15.4-inch center screen controls everything (climate, vents, glovebox).
features: Tesla Supercharger network with route planning
Acoustic glass throughout for noticeably quieter cabin
Dual wireless phone chargers in console
tesla-model-3.best_for: Tech-forward commuters who want the most polished mid-range EV

tesla-model-s-plaid.overview: Tri-motor electric sedan with 1,020 hp and the fastest production-car acceleration ever recorded — 1.99 seconds to 60 mph. Practical luxury wrapped around insanity.
tesla-model-s-plaid.drives_like: Physics-defying. Cheetah Stance lowers the front for launch. The Plaid pulls hard well past 150 mph. Yoke steering wheel is divisive — round wheel now optional.
features: 22-speaker premium audio with active road noise cancellation
HEPA cabin air filtration (Bioweapon Defense Mode)
Yoke or round steering wheel option
tesla-model-s-plaid.best_for: EV enthusiasts wanting the fastest accelerating production car

lucid-air-pure.overview: Stunning American EV with the best efficiency of any production car (~5 mi/kWh). Long Range RWD achieves 420+ miles. Interior styling rivals German flagships.
lucid-air-pure.drives_like: Smooth and silent like a Rolls, but with instant EV torque. Single motor RWD is surprisingly playful. 900V architecture enables ultra-fast 300+ kW charging.
features: Frunk and trunk for combined 32 cu-ft cargo
Premium leather and Alcantara interior options
lucid-air-pure.best_for: Range-anxious EV buyers who want luxury and efficiency

rivian-r1t.overview: World's first electric adventure truck. Quad-motor variant produces 835 hp, tows 11,000 lbs, and crawls rocks while doing 0-60 in 3.0 sec. A genuinely new vehicle category.
rivian-r1t.drives_like: Big but light on its feet. Tank turn mode pivots the truck in place. Air suspension raises clearance for trail use. Quad-motor torque vectoring is uncanny.
features: Gear Tunnel storage between cab and bed
1,500W house outlets (4 in bed, 2 in cab)
Air suspension with 7.9-15.4 inches of clearance
rivian-r1t.best_for: Outdoor adventurers and EV early-adopters who actually use trucks

hyundai-ioniq-6.overview: Streamlined electric sedan with class-leading 361-mile range (RWD Long Range) and 800V ultra-fast charging (10-80% in 18 minutes). Distinctive aero-focused styling.
hyundai-ioniq-6.drives_like: Quiet, smooth, and efficient. Steering is light but accurate. Suspension is comfort-tuned for highway cruising. Dual-motor AWD adds genuine quickness.
features: 800V electrical architecture (10-80% in 18 min on 350 kW charger)
Highway Driving Assist 2 with lane centering
Vehicle-to-Load (V2L) — power external devices from car battery
Heat pump standard for cold-weather range
hyundai-ioniq-6.best_for: Long-haul EV drivers and buyers wanting fastest-in-class DC charging

bmw-i7.overview: Flagship electric luxury sedan with a 31-inch 8K Theater Screen for rear passengers. Lounge-like back seat, 318-mile range, and BMW's most opulent cabin ever.
bmw-i7.drives_like: Silent and serene. The 5,500-lb i7 disguises its weight with active anti-roll bars and adaptive air suspension. Rear-seat passenger experience is the real story.
features: 31.3-inch 8K rear Theater Screen with Amazon Fire TV
Highway Assistant (hands-off lane keep up to 85 mph)
Available Bowers & Wilkins Diamond Surround Sound (36 speakers)
Available Executive Lounge rear seating with massage
bmw-i7.best_for: Chauffeured executives and luxury buyers who care most about rear-seat experience
